_comment: Intentional exceptions for tools/qa. Every entry needs a reason. untranslated: i18n keys whose non-English value may equal English (check-i18n.mjs; trailing * = prefix). visibleEnglish: English text allowed on non-English pages (sweep.mjs). sweep: suppress specific sweep issues; fields check/route/lang/viewport are exact matches, match is a substring of the issue detail; omitted fields match anything.

untranslated.reason: "Puzzle Rush" is a mode name and stays in English

visibleEnglish.reason: Mode name, kept in English in every language (like chess.com)
